links.outcome: Software sensitivity and specificity versus routine screening grading, both compared with ophthalmologist reference grading
links.effect: Software sensitivity 84.9%, specificity 89.9%, PPV 92.1%, NPV 81.0%; routine grading 87.0%, 85.3%, 89.2%, 82.5%; overlapping confidence intervals; AUC 93.4%.
links.quote: The software performed similarly to routine grading with overlapping confidence intervals, indicating comparable performance between the two groups.

screen.reason: Evaluates diagnostic performance (retrospective validation) of a commercially available SVM software (RetinaLyze) compared to human ophthalmologist grading on screening program images, without testing a deployment practice.
